name: coss ui
summary: Copy-paste React component library built on Base UI and Tailwind CSS; originui.com now redirects here.
description: coss ui (formerly Origin UI; originui.com redirects here) is Cal.com's official design system: 50+ accessible React components built on Base UI primitives and styled with Tailwind CSS. Components install through the shadcn CLI or by copying files, and the docs cover styling, migration from Radix/shadcn, llms.txt and agent skills. It also ships particles: 510 pre-assembled patterns such as auth forms and tables.
contains: 510 particles (pre-assembled patterns like auth forms and tables)
